The '''warspear''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] used by the people of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], and favored by the city guard of [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]].

==Description==
The warspear was a double-edged throwing [[Spear/Legends|spear]] constructed of a sturdy material. Used to [[Melee/Legends|parry]] other weapons, the spear was heavy and simple to master. It could be used by either striking the enemy at close range, or by throwing it through the air.
